command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo call_state=$ST; test "$ST" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true >/dev/null; FAIL=0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do if adb devices | awk 'NR>1 {print $1,$2}' | grep -q "^$SERIAL device$"; then echo adb_tick_$i=ok; else echo adb_tick_$i=missing; FAIL=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$FAIL" = "0"; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'AiCallBridge.*(shizuku_probe_result|offcall_parity_ok=|service_uid=)' | tail -n 80 || true); printf '%s\n' "$OUT"; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'offcall_parity_ok=true'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'service_uid=2000'; echo phase2c_adb_stability_offcall_ok=true
